notes.title: Minor fix for some stuck cases
notes.content: Some players encounter a stuck on loading (after "Happy Monster" or "Ready Fight"), hopefully this version will fix most of the cases.

notes.title: Roguelike card game To The Dungeon! :Embark on an exciting adventure with the adorable swordswoman.
notes.content:
[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/2445580/library_600x900_2x.jpg[/img] 

[h2]【About game】[/h2]

[u]*This game is an all-ages version of "Take Me to Dungeon!!". [/u]

Explore the depths of this massive dungeon with your adorable companion Una in this exciting rogue-like deck-building adventure!

[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/42396676/588bbfdf73ff4db8c63f823e2a30a32b4b67fcfd.gif[/img]

[h2]【Game Features】[/h2]
[list]
[*] Embark on an adventure in randomly generated dungeons, collect powerful treasures, and enjoy multiple buildings.
[*] Featuring over 50 cards and 20 runes
[*] With 20 basic CGs, including 11 beautiful Spine animations, and over 200 CGs! (variations included)
[*] Meet the adorable female protagonist and other characters who are both charming
[/list]
 
[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/41075428/41a5ccd2a7e98acac2ed0dca87c2062f9cfe5bbb.png[/img]

notes.title: Time to diving into dungeon for humanity,in the 2D side-scrolling game “Yusha Prototype”!
notes.content:
[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/2506060/library_600x900_2x.jpg[/img] 
[h2]【About game】[/h2]

"[i] Yusha Prototype[/i] " is a side-scrolling action game where you play as a combatant with the codename "Hero(Yusha)" venturing into dungeons to complete mission objectives. Use your exquisite skills to defeat monsters and bosses, acquire various loot and new techniques, and enhance your abilities to uncover the truth!
[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/41075428/b15fb2d1177498e6a29a62f28d36aad877116ee6.jpg[/img]

[h2]【Game Features】[/h2]
[list]
[*] Defeat unique enemies and bosses, acquire their techniques, and become stronger!
[*] Beautifully illustrated full-screen CG
[*] Detailed and lively defeat animations
[/list]
